release_object_delta.scope: Same Release binary with tauri/custom-protocol embedded production UI. Full mode is current code with diagnostic full notifications, not an older commit. CUA-generated native mouse drags and AX observations; excludes physical input, OS queue, display photons. Two >=30s operation blocks per trial; block/tool gaps excluded from active_operation_seconds, raw capture spans both blocks.
release_object_delta.warmup: Initial 10px drag at every process start; alternating pair before later trials. All excluded with byte offsets. Six processes in alternating mode groups; five trials per mode, not five processes per mode.
release_object_delta.conclusion: Notification payload reduced about 98.9% and delivery p95 median reduced about 22%. Pointer-up and presentation p95 changes are small with overlapping trial ranges; no material presentation-latency improvement established. Canvas redraw remains the dominant measured interval.

surface_frame_latency_experiment.decision: Reject lowering desired frame latency from 2 to 1. Keep FIFO and default 2.
surface_frame_latency_experiment.scope: Two short 24-drag trials per setting, order 2/1/1/2; not 60-second x 5 acceptance. At this stage direct release previews were not marked in the renderer; presentation/stage samples cover the tracked frames, while pointer-up/release-preview durations cover the whole handler. This gap is corrected by subsequent renderer entry capture.
surface_frame_latency_experiment.findings: Surface acquisition dominates tracked redraw. Requested latency 1 raises tracked latest-handler-to-present p95 to 33.710/32.984ms versus 17.071/16.252ms with 2. Release-preview p95 raises from about 1.1ms to about 17.7ms. Investigation found an immediate second redraw after the already presented release preview.

release_frame_reuse.decision: Accept one-time reuse after confirmed final vector translation presentation, matching document/revision/canvas. Preserve initial draw, final preview, commit, notifications, SVG worker scheduling and FIFO=2. Exclude duplication and text resizing.
scope_notes: Actual CUA mouse drags with AX observation; 24 drags per trial, 2 trials per mode, 96 drags total. This is not the 60s x 5 acceptance run.
Presentation populations change: baseline 72+72, reuse 48+49. One redundant frame per release is removed. Pointer-up stages remain 24 per trial and corroborate reduced handler blocking.

Renderer now captures active input for direct release previews. Native redraw no longer marks inputs before a possibly skipped draw. Older experiments have different marker coverage and are not directly compared.
A retained pending input can span a later input; first/latest durations remain separately available. Published avoided counters are cumulative and their range is not an exact drag count.
Undo/Redo visual selection and AX geometry verified; original fixture restored and saved. Physical input, OS queue and display photons excluded.
Longer repeated trials, text/duplicate/multiple-selection/scaled/effect variants and other platforms remain follow-up validation.
